action_items: Already-fixed-by-tester (verify in code review): /app/frontend/src/pages/DeliveryLoginPage.js — line 5 import was missing 'ChevronLeft'. Used at line 54 (back-button icon). Caused JS pageerror 'ChevronLeft is not defined' on every /delivery/login mount. Fixed by appending ChevronLeft to the lucide-react import. Re-tested: 0 pageerrors after fix.
critical_code_review_comments: DeliveryLoginPage.js had a refactor leak — likely the prior monolithic App.js had ChevronLeft imported globally and the extraction missed adding it. Recommend running `eslint --rule 'no-undef:error'` on the new /pages directory once to catch any other missed icon imports.

Sonner Toaster centralisation is correctly implemented — App.js renders <Toaster position='top-center' richColors /> exactly once at line 2234, and the search across CustomerSpace.js + VendorDashboard2026.js confirms 0 duplicate instances. The previous 12-instance bug is structurally impossible to recur unless someone re-adds <Toaster> to a sub-component.

The non-blocking console warning 'Received true for non-boolean attribute jsx' is from styled-jsx tags somewhere in the tree (not a refactor regression — pre-existing). Worth a future cleanup pass: replace `<style jsx>` with regular CSS modules or Tailwind to silence.

AdminDashboardPage.js at 1118 lines is approaching the file-size threshold (>700 lines guideline). Consider extracting its sub-panels (Vendeurs/Livreurs/Commandes/Clients/Settings) into their own files to keep parity with the Finance panel which is already external.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The 12-Toaster removeChild bug is structurally fixed. App.js: 1 import (line 5) + 1 JSX (line 2234). To regression-test: attach a pageerror listener and click the 7 customer tabs in succession (Accueil→Commandes→Wallet→Favoris→Messages→Fidélité→Profil). 0 errors expected. If a future PR re-introduces a local <Toaster> anywhere under App, this will resurface — recommend a CI grep gate: `grep -r '<Toaster' src/ | wc -l` must equal 1. rca of the issue: Original removeChild crash root cause (now fixed): Sonner's <Toaster> renders into a DOM portal at document.body. With 12 component-local <Toaster> instances mounting/unmounting on every route change (App.js had Toaster duplicated in CustomerSpace, VendorDashboard, AdminDashboard, multiple login pages, etc.), React's reconciler tried to remove a portal node that another Toaster's effect had already cleaned up — yielding 'Failed to execute removeChild on Node: The node to be removed is not a child of this node'. Fix: keep exactly one global <Toaster> at App() level. Verified via grep + 7-tab navigation in customer dashboard (the previously-crashing path) — 0 errors. New (minor) bug found this run: DeliveryLoginPage.js used <ChevronLeft/> without importing it (likely an artifact of the App.js extraction). Symptom: 'ChevronLeft is not defined' pageerror on every /delivery/login mount. Mitigation: appended ChevronLeft to lucide-react import on line 5. Re-tested: 0 pageerrors.
